# Design reference provenance

Source: [VoltAgent/awesome-design-md](https://github.com/VoltAgent/awesome-design-md), commit `3b605329240ce735b510037cca322f1831fdd7f8`, MIT, Copyright 2026 VoltAgent.

DevFlower adapts component typography, neutral surfaces, four-pixel spacing and restrained elevation from `design-md/vercel/DESIGN.md`, with reading/surface principles from Cursor and Claude and canvas grouping considerations from Miro. These documents analyze brand websites, including marketing pages; DevFlower uses application-sized controls and its own verified canvas interactions. No brand identity, proprietary fonts, logos or screenshot assets are copied. The adjacent license preserves the upstream notice. The local skill is an adapter for this collection; upstream does not provide a Codex SKILL.md.

Project rules: `docs/design/WORKBENCH_DESIGN.md`. The application builds without an installed Codex skill or network access to the reference repository.
